tools.name: app-store-search
tools.description: Search Apple's App Store by keyword in any storefront country and get each app's developer, price, rating, version, release date, genre, size, minimum OS and store URL. Read from itunes.apple.com when called. Each result: app_id, name, developer, developer_id, bundle_id, price, formatted_price, curr

tools.name: clinical-trials-monitor
tools.description: Studies from the official ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 for a condition, phase and status, returning only the studies whose status, phase, enrollment or last update changed since your last run. Read from clinicaltrials.gov when called. Each result: nct_id, title, sponsor, phase, status, enrollment, star

tools.name: eu-fuel-monitor
tools.description: Each run returns only the stations whose fuel prices changed since the last run, from the French and Spanish open government feeds, filtered by postcode prefix. Read from donnees.roulez-eco.fr, sedeaplicaciones.minetur.gob.es when called. Each result: country, station_id, postcode, address, city, la

tools.name: fr-company-search
tools.description: Search France's official company register by NAF activity code, département, headcount band and status, and get typed legal-entity records with head-office address, coordinates and company size. Read from recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr when called. Each result: siren, siret_head_office, name, leg

tools.name: scholarly-search
tools.description: Search the OpenAlex index of scholarly works by keyword, year range and open-access status, and get each paper's title, DOI, year, venue, type, citation count and open-access link. Read from api.openalex.org when called. Each result: openalex_id, title, doi, year, publication_date, venue, type, cite

tools.name: ted-tender-monitor
tools.description: New public procurement notices from the EU's official TED search API for a CPV code prefix, buyer country and keyword, returning only the notices that are new or changed since your last run. Read from api.ted.europa.eu when called. Each result: notice_id, publication_date, buyer, country_code, title

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "app-store-search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
